# stamp

> stamp is the Energy fleet's **Compliance / enterprise-readiness** tool-employee — the **governance & evidence**
> half of B2B trust. It gap-scans apps for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / HIPAA / ISO 42001 audit-readiness, plans the
> enterprise-**SSO program** (decide → price → prove), designs the audit-trail-as-a-CONTROL, runs access-reviews
> scoped to agent identities, proves whole-pipeline data residency, automates DSARs, and answers SIG/CAIQ/VSA
> questionnaires from a versioned KB. Its product is JUDGMENT — the six `brain/` files are the asset; the CLI / MCP
> / skills are thin surfaces that route a task to the right brain node. stamp is consumed by agents (Claude Code,
> the Energy hub, sibling employees — especially **badge**) via CLI + MCP, and by the chairman via a local
> cockpit. It is not a messaged product and not a re-built GRC platform (it drives Vanta/Drata as a tool).
> Powered by Energy.

## The boundary (read this first — the JTBD-0 gate)

**"badge = the connection; stamp = the program that decides we need it and proves it to the auditor."**
Place every task on the **mechanism↔governance** line: the auth *mechanism* (SAML/OIDC/SCIM code, signature
validation, event ordering, MCP-OAuth impl, provider $-breakpoint selection, RBAC *enforcement* at the token) is
**badge's** — ask stamp for it and it returns a `→ badge` handoff, not code. The *governance / evidence* (the
posture, the proof, the SSO *program*, the attestation) is **stamp's**. stamp also never claims "compliant"
(only "audit-ready evidence assembled"), never blesses an AI-only pen-test, and never auto-revokes access.

## CLI (`bin/stamp`) — every command takes `--json`

- `stamp audit <app|path> [--framework soc2|iso27001|hipaa] [--json]` — gap-scan a target app for SOC2-readiness → control-mapped gap report (severity + fix). NEVER prints "compliant" — only "audit-ready evidence: N gaps".
- `stamp sso-plan --target <app> [--acv <n>] [--dry-run] [--json]` — emit the enterprise-SSO **program** plan: buyer-readiness checklist + WorkOS Admin-Portal/SCIM wiring plan + deprovisioning-proof spec + the `→ badge` handoff for the mechanism. Does NOT hand-roll SAML.
- `stamp audit-log [--design|--check <path>] [--json]` — design/check the tamper-evident OTel-span trail (actor/target/before_hash/after_hash/trace_id, hash-chained, signed, SIEM-export).
- `stamp access-review [--scope all|privileged|agents] [--scim] [--json]` — run a UAR scoped to non-human + AGENT identities (derived from badge token scopes); PROPOSE revokes, a human approves; `--scim` adds IdP↔app reconciliation.
- `stamp residency [--ask] [--check <path>] [--json]` — ask "residency or sovereignty?" first; enumerate whole-pipeline pinning + the BYOK/CMK lever; flag the audit-log/LLM-call/tax-data gaps.
- `stamp dsar --type access|erasure [--json]` — classify → verify → apply-exemptions → draft → route across the subprocessor register on the GDPR/CCPA clock; a human signs.
- `stamp questionnaire <sig|caiq|vsa|path> [--kb <dir>] [--json]` — draft answers mapped to a versioned answer-KB; each marked "DRAFT — human must sign".
- `stamp advise --on <grc-platform|privacy|pentest|residency|repos> [--json]` — a DECISION with the honest cost (Vanta default; vet the auditor; verify vendor independence; check `pushed_at` not stars).
- `stamp runs [--since <ts>] [--json]` — aggregate `logs/runs.jsonl` (observability view, includes `human_owner`).
- `stamp --help` · `stamp --version`

## MCP server (`stamp-mcp`, stdio)

Endpoint: `node dist/mcp/server.js` (stdio JSON-RPC; registered as the `stamp` server in `.mcp.json`, env-refs only).
8 tools (each wraps the same pure lib the CLI uses):

- `stamp_audit` · `stamp_sso_plan` · `stamp_audit_log` · `stamp_access_review` · `stamp_residency` · `stamp_dsar` · `stamp_questionnaire` · `stamp_advise`

Plus `stamp://brain/{file}` resources exposing the 6 brain files as readable MCP resources.

## The brain (stamp's knowledge — read these, do not re-research)

- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md) — the JTBD decision spine (JTBD-0 boundary gate + JTBD 1–11 router)
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md) — 16 named, dated incidents (the golden-task source)
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md) — P1–P25, each detect + avoid (Vanta token revocation, AI-pentest trap, …)
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](brain/OPINIONS.md) — O1–O25, always/never + source (the taste layer)
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md) — where the brain is thin / contested (FORM-OWN-VIEW)
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md) — Vanta/Drata/WorkOS/Cobalt defaults vs documented alts

Query the brain via `scripts/brain-search.sh "<query>"` (BM25 over `brain/**.md`, returns ranked cited hits).
